answer: During load shedding, the AC in your apartment will work with one air conditioner per apartment, marked with a green sticker. The lift will still operate on the generator. For weak gas flames, you can use the induction plate. The water heater will not work during a power cut. Please wait 30 minutes for hot water to return.

Running on the generator: lights, sockets, fridge, TV, Wi-Fi router, lifts, water pump, the gas hob, and **one air conditioner per apartment** (marked with a green sticker; the Penthouse has two).

**Not running on the generator** (because of power limits): the induction plate, microwave, oven, electric kettle, air fryer, hair dryer, washing machine and the water heater (geyser). During a cut, cook on the gas hob. Hot water will not heat during a power cut, but water already hot stays hot for a few hours."},{"source_id":"13.3","title":"Quick fixes","text":"House manual > 13. Maintenance and Troubleshooting > 13.3 Quick fixes

| Problem | What to try |
|---|---|
| No power in the apartment | Check the breaker board in the entrance closet (section 6.3). If the whole building is dark, wait for the generator (about 30 seconds). |
| AC not cooling | Check the mode is **Cool**, the temperature is 24 to 26 °C, windows are closed, and the remote batteries are fresh. During a power cut only the green-sticker AC works. |
| No hot water | Check the geyser switch outside the bathroom is on, and wait 30 minutes. The geyser does not work on the generator and its 2-hour timer may have switched it off. |
| Weak gas flame | Common on winter mornings. Use the induction plate. |
| Low water pressure | The booster pump is automatic. Wait 10 minutes, then message the host. |
| Wi-Fi not working | Unplug the router for 30 seconds (section 5.1). The 4G backup starts automatically. |
| TV remote not working | Replace the batteries from the TV-stand drawer. |
| Door keypad not responding | Touch the keypad to wake it and enter the code followed by **#**. If it still does not respond, call the emergency maintenance line. |"},{"source_id":"10.1","title":"Lifts","text":"House manual > 10. Building Amenities and Accessibility > 10.1 Lifts

The building has two lifts. They work during power cuts because they run on the generator. If a lift stops between floors, press the alarm button and call the security desk. Lahore (Punjabi: لہور; Urdu: لاہور‎) is Pakistan's second largest city after Karachi, and the capital of the north-eastern Punjab province. It is widely considered the country's cultural capital. Founded in legendary times, and a cultural centre for over a thousand years, Lahore has many attractions for the tourist.
